Print & Export

Print layouts and output

What used to happen on paper in a darkroom happens on screen here. Set the paper, the margins and the layout, and the print file comes out looking like that.

Starts as a black sheet, 6 columns × 7 rows, 2 mm gaps.

Cyanotype, glass plate and gelatin silver are made to look the part. They are not measured from real chemistry, plates or paper.

Printer ICC Profile Matching

Supports sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, and custom RGB printer ICC profiles.

Non-destructive Print Layouts

Borders are set the way you would set them in a darkroom, and the page renders to high-resolution 16-bit TIFF.
